body:
As ASVS v4 aims at being more with the times, should JWT and bearer tokens be mentioned here (including in the Control Objective) as well as the current requirements only mention session IDs?  3.19 kind of touches on it but does not touch on issues related to JWT (such as issues related to invalidation, protecting them as HttpOnly and similar methods are ineffective in this case, etc.).  I think we should add some JWT and other bearer token-specific guidance.

3.3: 2.26 covers this but with more detail.  So should this be moved here or just mentioned?

3.12: Perhaps have the 'Secure' flag as a separate point/requirement as it covers security in transit + to highlight the importance of securing session IDs in transit

PS.  Even the OWASP Session Management Cheat Sheet makes no mention of JWTs
